comments.value:
Confirmed the problem. The last update has strange effect on own camera, it's not more rocksolid. It gets even worser when room is busy.
Rotation and strafe are also not nice, camera moves in weird way. Even if you put camera locked in global world, and you move around, you will see the camera cannot keep it solid and moves around too much in sort of rubberbanding effect.
What happened with the camera in the last update? Never seen it since 2018, now camera is like rubber at your hand, it's like not more part of yourself but more part of world (sort of separated camera).
Upvoting this so it hopefully garners more attention. It's terrible during streaming.
Hi me, this issue was fixed a while ago now.

details:
When the camera is held and the player locomotes, it moves differently then expected, slightly amplified of the user's movement.
